Season pass shows the bonuses of each level and also your progress during the season. It can be shown by $$pass(or $$sp). Earn Pass XP to level up and unlock more bonuses.

Season 1[edit]

Level 1 (250 XP): Unlock weekly rewards with $$weekly

Level 2 (500 XP): -0:30:00 research time

Level 3 (1,000 XP): +$10,000.00 starting capital

Level 4 (2,500 XP): +5 starting land (doesn't affect land price)

Level 5 (5,000 XP): +$50,000.00 starting capital (stacks with other starting capital)

Level 6 (10,000 XP): +20 starting land (stacks with other starting land)

Level 7 (25,000 XP): -20% all required research materials and costs

Level 8 (50,000 XP): Start with a logistics center when reincorporating with at least $1B

Level 9 (100,000 XP): Start with a air traffic control when reincorporating with at least $1B

Level 10 (250,000 XP): Start with a HQ when reincorporating with at least $1B
